question: Who among the following wrote the famous song, ‘Amar Sonar Bangla’, which became the national anthem of Bangladesh after its independence in 1971 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** was a renowned poet, writer, composer, philosopher, and painter from India.
 
• He wrote the song 'Amar Sonar Bangla' in 1905 during the Swadeshi movement in Bengal.
 
• The song 'Amar Sonar Bangla' became the national anthem of Bangladesh after its independence in 1971.
 
• Tagore is also known for writing the Indian national anthem 'Jana Gana Mana' and was the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amar Sonar Bangla:**

 
 
• 'Amar Sonar Bangla' is a song written in the Bengali language by Rabindranath Tagore in 1905.
 
• The song was written during the first partition of Bengal, intended to unite Bengali people and promote the Swadeshi movement against the British rule.
 
• After the independence of Bangladesh in 1971, the first ten lines of the song were adopted as the national anthem of Bangladesh.
 
 
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore:**
 
 
• Rabindranath Tagore was born on May 7, 1861, in Kolkata, India.
 
• He was a polymath who reshaped Bengali literature and music, as well as Indian art with Contextual Modernism in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
 
• In 1913, he became the first non-European to receive the Nobel Prize for his book "Gitanjali" (Song Offerings).
 
• Tagore's literary work includes poetry, novels, short stories, dramas, and essays covering various topics, from politics to personal reflections.
 
 
 
• **Bangladesh Independence:**
 
 
• Bangladesh gained independence from Pakistan on December 16, 1971, following the Bangladesh Liberation War.
 
• The war was a result of the political and economic discrimination against the Bengali population of East Pakistan by the ruling authorities of West Pakistan.
 
• The declaration of independence was made on March 26, 1971, which is now celebrated as Bangladesh's Independence Day.
 
• The war led to the creation of the People's Republic of Bangladesh.
